title: NoteBuilder notebook (interchange format, version 2)
description: A NoteBuilder notebook as exported by File > Export and accepted by Import. A notebook is a list of sections; a section holds cards; a card holds slots (text, quizzes, sliders, formulas, charts...). Interactive variables live inside ONE card: a slider or compute writes a variable, and only text/compute/chart slots in that same card can read it. Unknown keys are rejected here so typos surface; the app itself ignores them. Semantic checks the schema cannot express (formula cycles, choice answer indexes within the options, equal-length table rows) are documented in docs/FORMAT.md and enforced by the app on import.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this schema for editors. Ignored by the app.

version.description: Interchange format version. Always write 2. Version 1 files (no notebook.cats) still import; the app derives cats from card tags.

notebook.description: The notebook: a title, optional subtitle, and an ordered list of sections.

name.description: Notebook title shown in the top bar.

subtitle.description: One-line description shown under the title.

width.description: Page width preset. Omit for the default.

cats.description: Tag categories in display order (the tag chips readers filter by). List every tag used in card.tags; extra tags are allowed.

sections.description: Sections in reading order. A section is a lesson-sized group of cards; a section with kind 'divider' is a chapter break.

section.description: A section (a lesson / room of cards), or a chapter divider when kind is 'divider'.

name.description: Section name shown in the sidebar.

kind.description: Set to 'divider' to make this a chapter break that starts a new part of the notebook. Dividers hold no cards (use "cards": []).

title.description: Heading shown above the section's cards (often the same as name).

subtitle.description: One-line lead-in shown under the section title.

width.description: Fixed section width in pixels. Omit to fill the page.

services.description: Study-mode tool bar features to enable, keyed by feature: pin, search, archive, notes, shuffle, flipAll, reset. Example: {"shuffle": true, "flipAll": true}.

svcOrder.description: Left-to-right order of the tool bar features (keys as in services).

svcW.description: Pixel widths of resizable tool bar features, keyed as in services.

card.description: A card: one idea, one question, or one interactive model. Slots stack top to bottom. A card is also the scope of its variables: sliders and computes write variables that only this card's slots (front and back) can read.

slots.description: The card's slots (its front face when verbs.flip is true).

back.description: Back-face slots of a flip card (set verbs.flip to true). Front and back share one variable scope.

tags.description: Concept tags for filtering and the coverage matrix, e.g. ["definition", "chain-rule"]. Declare them in notebook.cats.

accent.description: Accent color for the card frame, as a CSS hex color like "#6ea8fe".

w.description: Card width in twelfths of the section grid: 12 full (default), 6 half, 4 third, 3 quarter. Narrow cards sit side by side.

archived.description: Hides the card from the study grid unless the archive view is on.

flip.description: Flashcard: the card shows slots on the front and back on the back; readers click to flip.

bare.description: Render without a card frame, as plain page text (good for notes and headings).

slot.$comment: Adding a slot type is one localized edit here: add its name to properties.type.enum, add a $defs entry named <type>Props (camelCase for hyphenated types), and add one if/then branch to allOf.
slot.description: One content block inside a card. `type` picks the kind of block; `props` holds its settings (shape depends on type).

type.description: Slot kind: text (markdown + math), list, code, table, image, choice (quiz), slider (number input that writes a variable), text-input (free answer), compute (formula that writes a variable), chart (plot of y = f(x)), progress (completion meter).

props.description: Settings for this slot. The allowed keys depend on type (each type's props are defined below as <type>Props). Always an object; {} when there is nothing to set.

w.description: Slot width in twelfths of the card (default 12). Consecutive narrow slots wrap side by side, e.g. two sliders at w 6.

fuse.description: Join this slot and the next one into a single row cell.

fuseW.description: Relative share of a fused row this slot takes (default 1).

reveal.description: Show this slot only while a condition on a variable of this card holds, e.g. {"key": "rate", "op": ">=", "val": 10}.

key.description: A variable written by a slider or compute in this card.

val.description: Value to compare against (normally a number).

sequential.description: Hide until every earlier completable slot in the card is done.

locked.description: Disable (but show) until every earlier completable slot in the card is done.

hint.description: A collapsible hint shown under the slot.

textProps.description: Markdown prose. Supports # / ## / ### headings, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strike~~, ==highlight==, `code`, - bullet and 1. numbered lists, > quotes, | tables |, [links](https://...), $inline$ and $$display$$ LaTeX math (KaTeX), and {{name}} to print the live value of a variable from this card.

text.description: The markdown source. In JSON every LaTeX backslash must be doubled: "$\\frac{a}{b}$".

listProps.description: A bulleted, numbered, or checklist list. A 'check' list is a tracker readers tick off; the card counts as done when every item is ticked.

items.description: List items as plain text (no markdown or $math$; use Unicode such as x², π).

code.description: The source code (use \n for line breaks).

tableProps.description: A grid of text cells. The first row is the header. Every row must have the same number of cells.

rows.description: Rows of plain-text cells, e.g. [["Symbol", "Meaning"], ["μ", "mean"]]. Cells show no markdown or $math$: for math in a table, write a markdown table in a text slot instead.

src.description: Image URL using https:, http:, data:, or file:. Empty string for a placeholder.

choiceProps.description: A multiple-choice question that checks itself. Readers pick, submit, see right/wrong, then the explanation.

options.description: Answer options as plain text, at least 2 (no markdown or $math$: use Unicode such as x², √2, π, or put the math in q).

answer.description: 0-based indexes of the correct options, e.g. [1] for the second option. Every index must be less than options.length.

multi.description: Allow selecting more than one option (use when answer has several indexes).

explanation.description: Shown after the reader answers, right or wrong: why the answer is correct (markdown and $math$).

sliderProps.description: A number input that WRITES the variable `key` for this card. Other slots in the same card read it in formulas and as {{key}} in text.

key.description: Variable name: letters, digits, underscore; not starting with a digit. Avoid function/constant names (sin, e, pi, min, ...) and x (the chart axis).

showSlider.description: Show the drag track (default true); false gives a plain number box.

textInputProps.description: A free-text answer box for open questions or reflection. Done once the reader writes something. It does not create a variable.

placeholder.description: Prompt shown in the empty box.

computeProps.description: A formula that reads this card's variables and WRITES the variable `out`; shows `note` followed by the result.

expr.description: Expression, e.g. "round(P * (1 + r/100) ^ t)". Operators + - * / % ^ // == != < <= > >= && || ! and c ? a : b; functions sin cos tan exp log sqrt abs sign round floor ceil min max pow clamp; constants pi e true false.

out.description: Variable name this formula writes (other slots of the card read it).

note.description: Plain-text label shown before the result, e.g. "Future value =".

chartProps.description: A live plot of y = fn(x). `x` is the horizontal axis; every other name in fn is a variable of this card, so the curve moves when a slider changes.

fn.description: Expression in x (same grammar as compute), e.g. "a * x^2 + b".

x0.description: Left end of the x range (default 0). Always set x0 and x1.

x1.description: Right end of the x range; must be greater than x0.

y0.description: Bottom of the y range; omit y0 and y1 to auto-fit.

hover.description: Show the value under the pointer.

progressProps.description: A progress meter: how many of the cards that have something to finish (a quiz, a checklist, an answer box) the reader has finished.

scope.description: What to count: this section, this chapter (up to the next divider), or the whole notebook.

track.description: Optional tags to count only cards carrying them.
